title: I’m experimenting with a new “test game” preview for AutoSprite.
author: beelllllll
selftext:
One problem I’ve had with AutoSprite is that it supports both isometric spritesheets and sidescroller spritesheets, but previewing them cleanly has been a little awkward.



Right now I have two separate preview/test games, and it can get confusing.



This 2.5D setup seems like it might solve that: one test game that can show off both styles.



If anyone has ideas for better ways to preview spritesheets, especially isometric + sidescroller characters in a small test game, I’d love to hear them.



Ideally, I want to make “one game” that works well for a wide variety of styles and characters.



Would love any feedback!
